sourceFidelityCaveat.line: THUS ORDERED AND SIGNED this ___ day of ___, 20___ at ___, Louisiana.
sourceFidelityCaveat.problem: the retained Article 995 capture is a legis.la.gov browser print whose text layer INTERLEAVES this line with the year and place blanks.
sourceFidelityCaveat.treatment: the line is NOT lifted verbatim. Its constituent blanks - day, month and year, and place - are rendered as court-owned fields beneath the heading THUS ORDERED AND SIGNED. This is a defect in the capture's text layer rather than in the statute, and it is one more reason the record's own open question about a court-ready rendering of these articles is not answered by this build.

authorityDecision.text: The statutory forms prescribed by Louisiana C.Cr.P. arts. 987 through 995 and 998 are treated uniformly as COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY. Generate them faithfully from the current codified article text. Existing PDF renderings of neighbouring articles are references, not a different product class. Do not wait for separate agency-issued fillable PDFs.
authorityDecision.scopeNote: The decision names arts. 987-995 and 998 by number and states the principle that neighbouring-article PDF renderings are references rather than a different product class. Families keyed to arts. 976, 977, 978 and 985 are applied under that stated principle rather than under the numbered range; that reading is recorded here rather than assumed silently.

authorityGrantDiscrepancy.what: This family's composedFromAuthority names LA-CCRP-ART-988 and LA-CCRP-ART-994. It does not name LA-CCRP-ART-995, which is the officialFormId of the REQUIRED proposed order on the same owner's packet-set manifest and is the second of this family's two bound sources.
authorityGrantDiscrepancy.whereItIsNamed: the determination's own operative text names it inside a numbered range: 'The statutory forms prescribed by Louisiana C.Cr.P. arts. 987 through 995 and 998 are treated uniformly as COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY.'
authorityGrantDiscrepancy.alsoOmittedBy: MASTER_QUEUE.json for this family lists forms, sourceIds and sourceReadiness.satisfiedByAuthority of 988 and 994 only, while its own sourceHashes bind the Article 995 text.
authorityGrantDiscrepancy.howThisBuildTreatedIt: It composed the Article 995 order under the determination's numbered range rather than under this family's own summary of it, asserted both halves at build time so neither can drift silently, and recorded the reading here and in build-findings.json rather than assuming it. It is put to counsel in approval-request.json. The same discrepancy shape appears on la-977d-marijuana-first-offense-set for Article 998.
authorityGrantDiscrepancy.notEditedHere: OWNER_DETERMINATIONS_2026-09-02.json and MASTER_QUEUE.json are central records and were not modified by this lane.
